Gold.note: Central bank buying and geopolitical hedging support prices despite high levels.

Silver.note: Industrial solar demand offsets recent pullback and monetary tailwinds persist.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and grid electrification demand drive strong bullishness.

Uranium.note: Persistent primary supply deficits and global nuclear renaissance support upside.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and EV demand growth deceleration weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Indonesian NPI and MHP oversupply continues to pressure the market.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapses and mine supply constraints tighten the market.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets stimulus measures and high port inventories.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand softens amid mild weather while metallurgical remains resilient.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls and strategic stockpiling offset weak near-term auto demand.

Manganese.note: South African logistics bottlenecks tighten supply but global steel demand remains soft.

PGM.note: Weak global auto production and substitution effects pressure platinum and palladium.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural application rates balance against ample global inventories.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and rising green energy demand tighten the balance.

Diversified.note: Heavy exposure to copper and gold provides strong macro and structural tailwinds.
